definitions.PDR: Proactive Detection Rate (PDR): estimated share of policy-violating content detected/removed by automated or platform-initiated systems before a user report. Used as 20% sub-input: RemovalRate_adj = 0.80 × reactive_removal + 0.20 × PDR.
definitions.RAS: Regulatory Accountability Score (RAS): transparent coding rubric (0–1) for DSA/VLOP transparency, law-enforcement cooperation, and documented regulatory pressure. Used as 30% sub-input: Consistency_adj = 0.70 × reported_consistency + 0.30 × RAS.

YouTube.source_document: Google/YouTube Transparency Report 2023; CA AB 587 Q4 2023 report

YouTube.coding_rule: PDR cannot be taken as 99.5% because comment removals are spam-dominated (~85%) and automated-first-detection ≠ gendered-harm-specific proactive removal. Apply harm-relevance discount d=0.75 to video automated-first-detection anchor: PDR = 0.961 × 0.75 = 0.721 → 0.72.
